resources.string:
Where the Quintek server is running. Leave empty to use the built-in demo data. Typically a computer on the same Wi-Fi running:

python -m benchmark.cli serve-student --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8500

That one serves the learner app: notebooks, questions, progress and billing, plus the AI transparency screen. The benchmark console needs serve-analytics on 8420 instead, which does not serve the learner routes.
Include http:// or https:// at the start
